ActorTalk: We let people throw in wish slips here, sure, but... isn't this a bit much...? Sigh...
Oh, hello there, Gray Raven's Commandant. You must have noticed that girl over there too, right?
So many students started doing the same thing as that girl, writing their wishes on slips and throwing them into the pool.
Sigh, cleaning all this up is such a hassle...
Oh, right, Gray Raven Commandant, if you have time, could you help me salvage these wish slips?
At some point, a rumor started going around that if you dropped a wish slip into the pool, your wish might come true.
